comparison.objective: Fit a long wardrobe rail into one closed cup and one open support.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual manipulation of a long part using tilted insertion followed by swing-down placement.
comparison.success_condition: Left end at least 0.8 cm into the cup, right end on the support, rail within 1° of level, released and still for 1 s.
comparison.reason: The tested ability is cooperative long-part insertion under geometric constraints, not small-tool alignment, hammering, fracture, and debris recovery.
